name: type:bug
description: Something that works, or should, behaves wrongly

name: type:feature
description: New behaviour with acceptance criteria

name: type:prototype
description: A spike or exploration; the output is an answer, not kept code

name: type:design
description: Needs a design decision or spec before any code

name: type:docs
description: Documentation only: README, CLAUDE.md or a spec; no behaviour change

name: size:S
description: Under half a day, one package, no contract change

name: size:M
description: One to two days, or one PR across two packages

name: size:L
description: Several days, or a stack of PRs

name: size:XL
description: Too big to start; split it first

name: agent:build
description: Opt in: the nightly run builds this issue, whatever its size

name: hold
description: Paused by a person: the nightly run neither builds nor pushes it

name: nightly:generated
description: Opened by the nightly run

name: nightly:paused
description: On the Nightly triage issue: the next run does nothing

name: epic:approved
description: The epic's owner approved it: /epic approve may create its sub-issues

name: PR Ready
description: Its author checked this draft: their PR steward may mark it ready and have it reviewed

name: coderabbit done
description: CodeRabbit reviewed it once, its findings are answered, and reviews are paused

name: needs owner
description: A design choice or a larger ask waits for the PR's author; their PR steward skips it until answered

name: needs owner review
description: The PR steward fixed this Dependabot PR; a teammate approves the new head before it merges

name: decided-by-bot
description: The PR body records a Minor decision the PR steward made

name: merge-risk:minimal
description: Set by the PR steward: CodeRabbit rates the merge risk Minimal

name: merge-risk:low
description: Set by the PR steward: CodeRabbit rates the merge risk Low

name: merge-risk:moderate
description: Set by the PR steward: CodeRabbit rates the merge risk Moderate

name: merge-risk:high
description: Set by the PR steward: CodeRabbit rates the merge risk High

name: merge-risk:critical
description: Set by the PR steward: CodeRabbit rates the merge risk Critical
